reader_findings.finding: The question has none and empty answer_ids while the same frozen reading contains the explicit request for a blessing and its answer edge. This is a represented-inventory inconsistency/risk, not evidence that the source lacks an answer. Producer want_q/request/request_answer preserves the actual reply.

The question What are mesargin and memattchin is reconstructed from reported definitions beginning איתמר, not an explicit interrogative at that locus. Retain as editorial reconstruction. This is context-only and gives no extra compared-core credit.

Answers can be complementary reason-specific responses or components of one narrative. In particular the dismissal מילין בעלמא הוא דאמר לי is a real conversational reply to מאי אמר לך; the answer edge is supported, but it is not the wording of the blessing. Initial reviewer suspicion of wrong target is withdrawn after reading the complete exchange. Do not export these as mutually exclusive scholar choices.

Reader leaves local pronouns unresolved. Producer resolves the blessing to Rav and recipient to R Shimon ben Halafta from the printed opening and return sequence, retaining unnamed parenthetical father. This is a supported contextual reading, not a new explicit name in the blessing clause; retain ambiguity and disallow certainty-based downstream attribution. No name-order inference from חד אמר occurs.

Hypothetical/ asserted labels describe different layers: a proposed argument later challenged, a spoken wish rather than predicted event, and an asserted report of an accusation rather than adjudicated blame. Producer scopes and correction edges preserve these distinctions. No automatic error from label mismatch.

semantic_assessment: All117 independent core claims compared to original source and active producer counterparts. All18 core questions compared;4 context questions not included in core denominator.

All112 reader relations inspected with endpoint claims and continuations; context-only edges remain separately counted. Producer answer, support, objection, correction and distinction targets reviewed semantically, not inferred from quote-match alone.

Marriage reasons retain Shmuel via Rav Yehuda, Oshaya versus alternative Hanina via Elazar, Rabbah bar [Rav] Huna, Rav via Daniel bar Katina, Ulla and Yitzhak Nappaha. Abaye identifies a prior reason and addresses Rav Yosef; no invented dispute.
Festival-eve responses answer distinct rationales. Solomon construction proposals are challenged, and redundant seven-plus-seven supplies the replacement proof.

Temple-inauguration narratives retain exceptional scope, named transmission, heavenly voice versus narrator, divine/human-need distinction, rejected first/seventh-day and fourteen-day proofs, consecutive-day replacement and day-day analogy.

Tahlifa exposition and Rav narrative continuations can be attributed at enclosing narrative level or anonymous continuation level; quoted Solomon and heavenly voice are not amoraic personal legal positions.

Repeated leave-taking conditions and joint-student teaching preserve transmission to their teacher. Torah-versus-mitzvah replies distinguish performable-by-others conditions rather than assigning opposed views to the two students.

Blessings retain negative surface wording and positive explanations, corrected initial complaints, relational unnamed son and parenthetical father. Rav attribution in the second narrative remains contextual with uncertainty restriction.

Adornment permits old as well as young; lime removable during festival preserves later-joy condition. Rav Nahman bar Yitzhak and Ravina answer different sides of the collection comparison, without forcing a retraction. Rav Yehuda differs from Rabbi Yehuda; the printed כותי is preserved.
Bed-weaving definitions in10a continuation preserve unresolved paired authorities, challenge and Ravin replacement; these context claims do not add admission.
